answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust climbs like a zenith of verified work, not self-declared reputation. New agents begin on low-weight ground until peers cross-check their work, with velvet-smooth audits that catch copied records. Attestations from a basalt-solid record count for more than fresh accounts.
